# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v4 c26 P4](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c27 P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c37 P0](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Marysville, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin has a round head covered in fuzzy yellow ringlets, a snub nose, and hazel eyes filled with roguish mischief. He has a wide, smiling mouth and a single dimple in his cheek that gives him a sweet and amusing look when he laughs. Over the years, he grows into a tall, healthy, and energetic boy.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025), [v4 c27 P0](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0000)_

## Personality

Robin is an exceedingly energetic, inquisitive, and mischievous boy who constantly finds himself in trouble. Though prone to impulsive antics and occasional fibs, he possesses an affectionate and loving heart, particularly toward Nell. He is endlessly curious about the world, frequently asking questions about how things work or why rules exist.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c14 P16](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0016)_

## Goals

- To grow up into a man and be like Mr. Pettifer  <sub>[v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), [v3 c8 P23](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0023)</sub>
- To manage the farm at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003)</sub>

## History

Following the death of his mother, Robin and his twin sister Lucy are brought to Grey Shutters by Thirza Abernethy. Robin immediately fills the household with lively chaos, constantly indulging in mischievous pranks such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, tricking Lucy into falling into a pigpen, and putting a toad in Thirza's bed. Though his antics frequently test Thirza's patience, he forms a deep emotional bond with Nell, who guides his moral understanding with gentle lessons. When he starts attending school, he continues his playful ways alongside his classmate Milty Gammon, but gradually matures into a helpful and energetic young farmhand. As he grows older, he takes pride in helping Thirza around Grey Shutters and expresses an eager ambition to manage the farm himself.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P0](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0000), [v3 c10 P55](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0055), [v3 c21 P1](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0001), [v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Born one of three sets of consecutive twins to Mr. and Mrs. Rudge in Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Orphaned at a young age after his father passed away and his sick mother died at East Welby  <sub>[v2 c1 P34](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0034), [v3 c8 P0](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Taken in by Thirza Abernethy to be raised at Grey Shutters alongside his twin sister Lucy  <sub>[v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v3 c8 P0](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0000)</sub>
